description: G5 fail-safe red-flag escalation record. Emitted by mitate_emergency_screen cell when red-flag pattern detected (anaphylaxis / orbital cellulitis / septal abscess / 髄膜炎 / 視力低下 / 意識障害 / 突然の重度頭痛). Triggers immediate ER routing instruction to patient PWA + on-call DID urgency-only push notification (G11 carve-out: emergency ack is one of the 3 permitted notification types). Public ack only — no patient identity in record. Per ADR-2605260100 §Decision 3 G5 (architectural invariant: bypass 不可).

intakeUri.description: Back-reference to rhinitisIntake record. Patient pseudonym DID is NOT included here (G10) — only the intake reference. To resolve to patient, decryption of intake envelope is required (G2 access).

erRoutingInstruction.description: Jurisdiction-aware patient-facing instruction (Japan: 119 救急車 / nearest ER list / hospital network search instruction).

onCallNotifiedDids.description: DIDs of on-call physicians / Council medical advisory members notified via G11 urgency-only push channel.

patientAckReceivedAt.description: Optional — patient acknowledgment that ER routing instruction was received (best-effort, do not block on patient response).

downstreamPipelineSuppressed.description: Architectural invariant — must be true. If false, indicates a bypass violation (G5 fail-safe inviolability breach).
